role: Connects to /ws/supervisor WebSocket endpoint and feeds supervisor verdicts into Zustand store with automatic reconnection.
detail: Exports useSupervisorWebSocket() hook that manages a persistent WebSocket connection to the supervisor endpoint. Uses exponential backoff with jitter (base 1000ms × 2^attempt, capped 30000ms, jitter 0.8–1.2×) for reconnection scheduling. Parses incoming JSON messages with type='supervisor_verdict', extracts SupervisorVerdict payload, and dispatches via addVerdict() into supervisorSlice store. Handles open/error/close events with console logging; cleans up connection and pending timeouts on unmount. Mirrors pattern from useGraphWebSocket and useTelemetryWebSocket. Derives WS URL dynamically (wss: for https, ws: for http) from window.location.
